budget.title: Full-Day Szentendre Art & Old Town + Local Budget Food
budget.summary: A full day of colorful streets, small galleries, churches, and traditional Hungarian/Serbian food that doesn’t destroy your budget.

schedule.title: Fő Tér Warm-Up
schedule.description: Start on the main square of Szentendre — colorful facades, old houses, and the first small galleries all around you.

schedule.title: Old Town Gallery Hopping
schedule.description: Visit a few small private galleries and studios hidden in side streets — lots of paintings, handmade crafts, and local artists.

schedule.title: Serbian Orthodox Church Courtyard & View
schedule.description: Walk up to the Serbian Orthodox church area for a mix of history, art, and a nice view over the rooftops.

schedule.title: Budget Local Lunch
schedule.description: Try a traditional Hungarian or Serbian-inspired meal — goulash soup, stew, stuffed peppers, or simple daily menus at a modest restaurant.

schedule.title: Marzipan Museum or Quirky Museum of Your Choice
schedule.description: Visit the famous Marzipan Museum or another fun small museum — light, playful, and very Szentendre-style.

schedule.title: Art Mill (Művész Malom)
schedule.description: Head to the Art Mill for contemporary art exhibitions in an old industrial building — a cool contrast to the old town streets.

schedule.title: Evening Walk & Simple Drink
schedule.description: Finish the day with a walk along the Danube and a simple drink or coffee at a low-key place near the river.

comfortable.title: Full-Day Szentendre Art Journey with Comfortable Local Dining
comfortable.summary: A curated art and architecture day through Szentendre with a cozy sit-down lunch and a relaxed evening finish.

schedule.title: Coffee & First Look at Fő Tér
schedule.description: Start with a good coffee on or near the main square, watching the town wake up around the colorful buildings.

schedule.title: Old Town Art & Architecture Walk
schedule.description: Stroll through narrow streets, take in balconies, church towers, and small galleries tucked into old houses.

schedule.title: Serbian Orthodox Church & Museum Area
schedule.description: Visit the church surroundings or small museum (if open) to see icons, religious art, and traces of the Serbian community.

schedule.title: Comfortable Local Lunch
schedule.description: Enjoy a proper sit-down meal — homemade-style Hungarian dishes or Serbian-influenced specialties in a cozy restaurant.

schedule.title: Marzipan Museum & Sweet Break
schedule.description: Explore the marzipan figures and displays, then treat yourself to something sweet — cake, marzipan, or dessert and coffee.

schedule.title: Art Mill & Design Corners
schedule.description: Head to the Art Mill and, if time allows, step into nearby design shops and studios with pottery, prints, and handmade items.

schedule.title: Early Evening Wine or Cocktail
schedule.description: End the day in a pleasant bar or wine spot — not wild nightlife, just relaxed drinks with an artistic town atmosphere.

budget.title: Full-Day Szentendre Art Tour with Light Veggie-Friendly Budget Meals
budget.summary: An artsy full-day route powered by light vegetarian-friendly food — perfect if you want culture without feeling too heavy.

schedule.title: Light Breakfast & Fő Tér Stroll
schedule.description: Grab a simple pastry, fruit, or yogurt, then wander around the main square and nearby streets to get the first feel of Szentendre.

schedule.title: Small Galleries & Creative Corners
schedule.description: Pick a couple of small galleries to visit — many local artists show their paintings, icons, and handmade crafts.

schedule.title: Church Viewpoint & Old Stairs
schedule.description: Walk up to one of the churches above the center and enjoy the view over the rooftops and river area.

schedule.title: Veggie-Friendly Budget Lunch
schedule.description: Find a bistro or café where you can order salads, soups without meat, or simple pasta/vegetable dishes.

schedule.title: Marzipan Museum or Alternative Museum
schedule.description: Choose a light, fun museum visit — marzipan figures or another quirky art-related stop.

schedule.title: Calm Café Break
schedule.description: Relax in a café, maybe with tea or a light dessert, and enjoy the slow small-town rhythm.

schedule.title: Danube Promenade Walk
schedule.description: End with a gentle walk by the river, maybe with a juice or lemonade in your hand.

comfortable.title: Full-Day Szentendre Art Immersion with Light Veggie Dining
comfortable.summary: A carefully paced art day with galleries, architecture, and healthy vegetarian meals in comfortable spots.

schedule.title: Café Breakfast with a View
schedule.description: Start with a sit-down breakfast — coffee or tea, plus something light like oats, fruit, or a pastry.

schedule.title: Architectural Walk Through the Old Town
schedule.description: Pay attention to doorways, windows, and church towers — the whole town feels like a painted scene.

schedule.title: Gallery Hopping
schedule.description: Visit one or two carefully chosen galleries — focus on places that showcase local painters or modern art.

schedule.title: Modern Veggie Lunch
schedule.description: Eat at a restaurant or café that offers salads, veggie plates, or modern bowls with fresh ingredients.

schedule.title: Creative Shops & Artisan Studios
schedule.description: Explore design shops, pottery studios, and places selling handmade crafts and prints.

schedule.title: Art Mill Visit
schedule.description: Head over to the Art Mill to see contemporary exhibitions in a unique industrial setting.

schedule.title: Evening Drink in an Artsy Bar
schedule.description: Wrap up with a drink in a bar with a creative vibe — relaxed lighting, background music, and a mix of locals and visitors.

budget.title: Full-Day Szentendre Art Tour for Curious Tasters (Budget)
budget.summary: Art, architecture, and a chance to try a bit of everything food-wise — all kept within a friendly budget.

schedule.title: Bakery Start & Old Town Walk
schedule.description: Pick two or three different pastries from a bakery and explore the main square and side streets while tasting.

schedule.title: Quick Gallery & Iconic Church
schedule.description: Step into a small gallery, then climb up to one of the churches for a mix of art and viewpoints.

schedule.title: Second Gallery or Museum Stop
schedule.description: Choose another artistic stop — maybe a small museum or another gallery that looks interesting.

schedule.title: Mixed Budget Lunch
schedule.description: Order a couple of smaller dishes to share — soup, a main, and maybe a side, so you can taste more without overspending.

schedule.title: Marzipan or Themed Museum Visit
schedule.description: Check out the marzipan figures or another unusual museum to keep things playful.

schedule.title: Snack & Coffee Break
schedule.description: Grab something small — a cake slice, a small dessert, or another local snack — with coffee or tea.

schedule.title: Casual Bar Finish
schedule.description: End the day in a budget-friendly bar with a relaxed crowd and simple drinks.

comfortable.title: Full-Day Szentendre Art Experience with Rich Food Variety
comfortable.summary: A full art-focused day with several tasting-style meals, scenic walks, and plenty of Szentendre charm.

schedule.title: Café Breakfast Tasting
schedule.description: Start with good coffee and one or two breakfast items — something savory and something sweet.

schedule.title: Artistic Old Town Walk
schedule.description: Wander through the most photogenic parts of town — squares, churches, and hidden passages.

schedule.title: Gallery + Design Shop Combo
schedule.description: Visit a gallery, then stop by a design or craft shop to see how art turns into objects you can actually use or wear.

schedule.title: Tasting Lunch
schedule.description: Choose a restaurant where you can share several smaller dishes — traditional, modern, and maybe a daily special.

schedule.title: Art Mill & Surroundings
schedule.description: Explore the Art Mill exhibitions and take a short walk around its surroundings for industrial-meets-art vibes.

schedule.title: Dessert & Coffee Stop
schedule.description: Sit down in a nice café for dessert and coffee — the sweet part of the day, literally.

schedule.title: Gastro Bar Evening
schedule.description: End in a bar where you can order small plates alongside your drinks — the perfect mix of food, drinks, and atmosphere.
